description.value: Kumsheen Rafting Resort has operated on the Thompson River near Lytton since 1973, hosting over 300,000 guests on whitewater trips down the Thompson and Fraser Rivers, including the iconic Hell's Gate section. The resort offers a range of accommodations from power campsites to king cabins, anchored by a central pool and hot tub area with views of White Canyon. Located in one of BC's hottest, driest regions just three hours from Vancouver, it functions as a full-service vacation destination with on-site dining and live weekend music.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating resort at the OSM address (1345 Trans-Canada Hwy, Lytton BC V0K1Z0), phone (250 455 2296), and email (rafting@kumsheen.com). The site describes accommodations (cabins, power campsites), on-site dining (Cutting Board Restaurant for breakfast and dinner), a pool/spa, and communal washrooms with electrical charging outlets, but contains no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities. The business is explicitly stated as open.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, long-established, publicly accessible resort accommodation confirmed open for the 2026 season. Useful overnight stop for cyclists on the Trans-Canada corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Toll-free number 1-800-663-6667 found on website is not in OSM tags but is supplementary contact info only.

Nearby evening food.detail: Cutting Board Restaurant on-site serves breakfast and dinner; FAQ confirms 'breakfast and dinner at The Cutting Board Restaurant'

Device charging.detail: Resort facilities page states communal washrooms contain 'electrical charging outl[ets]' at both the Reception Office lower level and the Barn
